correctness.rationale: Actual RESULT.md establishes the uniform-plus-atom chord law L=2/a and p=(a-b)/(a+b), with both endpoint cases p=0,1. Moment inversion recovers unordered absolute evaluations of two independent strip forms. S=alpha^2+beta^2 is reconstructed from three quadratic samples; five projective zeros of D^2-Dprime^2 force Dprime=plus/minus D, thus recover both rank-one strip squares. Two exact noncongruent strips [(2,0),(0,1)] and [(6/5,4/5),(-8/5,3/5)] give equal full chord laws along (1,1),(1,6),(1,-4),(3,-2). Independently rechecked rational evaluation equality, shape difference, and moment inversion. The arbitrary five-view assertion follows from polynomial root degree and does not rely on finite tests.
